papers.name: SkillOpt
papers.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
papers.summary: Treats a skill as the trainable external state of a frozen agent: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on one skill document and accepts an edit only if a held-out validation score strictly improves.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 当作冻结 agent 的可训练外部状态：由单独的优化器模型把打分后的 rollout 变成对一份 skill 文档的有界增、删、改，只有 held-out 验证分数严格提高时才接受修改。

papers.name: SkillAdam
papers.title: SkillAdam: Stable and Efficient Skill Evolution for Agents
papers.summary: Targets unstable and inefficient skill self-evolution through two principles: direction stability (effective corrections accumulate across iterations) and update adaptivity (the scope of a revision follows the consistency of feedback).
papers.summary_zh: 针对 skill 自进化不稳定、迭代效率低的问题，提出两条原则：方向稳定（有效的修正跨迭代累积）和更新自适应（修改范围随反馈的一致程度变化）。

papers.name: GraphSkillEvo
papers.title: GraphSkillEvo: Evolutionary Optimization of Graph-Structured Agent Skills
papers.summary: Represents skills as graph-structured natural-language artifacts to give explicit workflow-level guidance and to constrain the search space, and optimizes them with evolutionary search.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 表示成图结构的自然语言工件，提供显式的 workflow 级指导并约束搜索空间，再用进化搜索优化。

papers.name: MetaSkill-Evolve
papers.title: MetaSkill-Evolve: Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agents via Two-Timescale Meta-Skill Evolution
papers.summary: Makes skill self-improvement recursive with a two-timescale design in which the improvement procedure itself is evolved alongside the task skill instead of being authored once and held fixed.
papers.summary_zh: 用两个时间尺度让 skill 的自我改进变成递归的：改进流程本身和任务 skill 一起进化，不再是写一次就固定。

papers.name: SkillAdaptor
papers.title: SkillAdaptor: Self-Adapting Skills for LLM Agents from Trajectories
papers.summary: Training-free, step-level skill adaptation: for a failed trajectory it locates the first actionable fault step, attributes it to candidate skills, and applies targeted updates under explicit acceptance checks with a frozen backbone.
papers.summary_zh: 免训练的步骤级 skill 适配：在失败轨迹里定位第一个可处理的出错步骤，归因到候选 skill，在显式的接受检查下做针对性修改，backbone 保持冻结。

papers.name: SkillMentor
papers.title: SkillMentor: LLM Agent Self-Evolution via Learning Blind-Spot Diagnosis
papers.summary: Studies blind-spot diagnosis as a learnable capability separate from execution by training a Mentor policy while excluding executor updates and human supervision as sources of improvement.
papers.summary_zh: 把盲点诊断当作和执行分开的、可学习的能力：训练一个 Mentor 策略，同时排除执行模型更新和人工监督这两个改进来源。

papers.name: Trace2Skill
papers.title: Trace2Skill: Distill Trajectory-Local Lessons into Transferable Agent Skills
papers.summary: Consolidates many execution trajectories in parallel into a unified skill directory through inductive reasoning, either deepening human-written skills or building skills from weak LLM-generated drafts.
papers.summary_zh: 通过归纳推理，把大量执行轨迹并行地整合成一个统一的 skill 目录；既能加深人写的 skill，也能从较弱的 LLM 草稿出发构建 skill。

papers.name: Trace2Tower
papers.title: Trace2Tower: Transition-Aware EigenTrace Induction of Multi-Level Skills for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Abstracts step-level interactions into canonical events, builds a graph from semantic compatibility, transition dynamics, and outcome evidence, and applies a contrastive spectral decomposition to distill a multi-level skill hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh: 把步骤级交互抽象成规范事件，按语义相容性、转移动态和结果证据建图，再用对比式谱分解蒸馏出多层的 skill 层级。

papers.name: WikiSkill
papers.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
papers.summary: Co-evolves agent skills with a persistent wiki, separating raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills so that later skill updates can build on consolidated insights.
papers.summary_zh: 让 agent skill 和一个持久的 wiki 共同进化，把原始执行经验、累积的知识和可执行的 skill 分开，使后续的 skill 更新能建立在已整合的结论上。

papers.name: MASA
papers.title: Skill is Not One-Size-Fits-All: Model-Aware Skill Alignment for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Shows in controlled experiments that a skill helping one backbone can harm another, and adapts skills to each target backbone without changing agent weights, starting from a hierarchical skill evolution pipeline.
papers.summary_zh: 用对照实验说明对一个 backbone 有益的 skill 可能伤害另一个，并在不改 agent 权重的前提下按目标 backbone 适配 skill，第一阶段是分层的 skill 进化流程。

papers.name: SkVM
papers.title: SkVM: Revisiting Language VM for Skills across Heterogenous LLMs and Harnesses
papers.summary: Treats skills as code and LLMs as heterogeneous processors: decomposes a skill's requirements into primitive capabilities, measures how well each model–harness pair supports them, and compiles skills against these capability profiles.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 当代码、把 LLM 当异构处理器：将 skill 的需求分解成 primitive capability，测量每个模型和 harness 的组合支持到什么程度，再按这份能力画像编译 skill。

papers.name: SkCC
papers.title: SkCC: Portable and Secure Skill Compilation for Cross-Framework LLM Agents
papers.summary: A skill compiler built around SkIR, a strongly typed intermediate representation that separates skill semantics from framework-specific formatting to address cross-framework portability and security.
papers.summary_zh: 一个 skill 编译器，核心是强类型的中间表示 SkIR，把 skill 的语义和各框架特有的格式分开，处理跨框架可移植性和安全问题。

papers.name: SkillAlign
papers.title: SkillAlign: Aligning Skill Interfaces for LLM-based Agents
papers.summary: Represents candidate skills as multi-view procedural cards and renders them through alternative exposure interfaces (full instructions, hints, compressed summaries, workflows, or no exposure), enabling counterfactual evaluation of how a skill is shown to the agent.
papers.summary_zh: 把候选 skill 表示成多视图的过程卡片，并用不同的呈现方式（完整指令、提示、压缩摘要、workflow、不呈现）交给 agent，从而能对“怎么呈现 skill”做反事实评测。

papers.name: SkillAligner
papers.title: SkillAligner: Treating Retrieved Skills as Adaptable Drafts at Execution Time
papers.summary: Formalizes the skill–execution misfit and treats retrieved skills as adaptable drafts: a one-time, training-free joint adaptation before execution specializes skill fragments to the task and aligns their assumptions with the execution interface.
papers.summary_zh: 形式化了 skill 与执行不匹配的问题，把检索到的 skill 当作可改的草稿：执行前做一次免训练的联合适配，让 skill 片段贴合任务，并让它的假设和执行接口对齐。

papers.name: SkillsBench
papers.title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks
papers.summary: A benchmark of 87 tasks across 8 domains with curated skills and deterministic verifiers, evaluated under matched no-skill and curated-skill conditions for 18 model–harness configurations.
papers.summary_zh: 一个基准：8 个领域 87 个任务，配有人工整理的 skill 和确定性验证器，在 18 个模型与 harness 的组合上做了有 skill 和无 skill 的配对评测。

papers.name: SWE-Skills-Bench
papers.title: SWE-Skills-Bench: Do Agent Skills Actually Help in Real-World Software Engineering?
papers.summary: A requirement-driven benchmark that isolates the marginal utility of agent skills in software engineering by pairing 49 public skills with GitHub repositories pinned at fixed commits and execution-based acceptance tests.
papers.summary_zh: 一个由需求驱动的基准，把 49 个公开 skill 和固定 commit 的 GitHub 仓库、基于执行的验收测试配对，用来分离出 agent skill 在软件工程里的边际效用。

papers.name: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
papers.title: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
papers.summary: An evaluation framework in which a skill author builds realistic tasks to estimate a skill's utility, applied to 500 real-world skills with 1,000 generated tasks and instruction-following and goal-completion rubrics.
papers.summary_zh: 一个评测框架：skill 的作者可以构造贴近实际的任务来估计 skill 的效用；论文把它用在 500 个真实 skill 上，生成了 1,000 个任务，并配有指令遵从和目标完成两类评分标准。

papers.name: Agent Skill Framework: Perspectives on the Potential of Small to Medium Language Models in Industrial Environments
papers.title: Agent Skill Framework: Perspectives on the Potential of Small to Medium Language Models in Industrial Environments
papers.summary: Studies the skill paradigm for open-source models from 270M to 80B parameters on two open tasks and an insurance-claims task; very small models struggle with reliable skill selection, while models around 30B–80B benefit substantially.
papers.summary_zh: 在两个公开任务和一个保险理赔任务上，研究 270M 到 80B 的开源模型使用 skill 的效果：很小的模型难以可靠地选对 skill，30B 到 80B 左右的模型收益明显。

papers.name: From Raw Experience to Skill Consumption: A Systematic Study of Model-Generated Agent Skills
papers.title: From Raw Experience to Skill Consumption: A Systematic Study of Model-Generated Agent Skills
papers.summary: A systematic study of model-generated, domain-level skills across the full lifecycle of experience generation, skill extraction, and skill consumption, asking whether, when, and why such skills work.
papers.summary_zh: 对模型生成的领域级 skill 做系统研究，覆盖经验生成、skill 提取、skill 使用的完整生命周期，考察这类 skill 是否有用、何时有用以及原因。

papers.name: AgentLeak
papers.title: AgentLeak: Cloning Stronger LLM Agent Capabilities onto Weaker Agents Beyond Skill Stealing
papers.summary: A security study showing that leaking explicit skill artifacts does not by itself transfer capability to a weaker agent, because the stronger agent also relies on implicit procedural behaviors; relevant as evidence on the limits of skill-text transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 一项安全研究：只泄露显式的 skill 工件并不能把能力转移给较弱的 agent，因为较强的 agent 还依赖隐式的过程行为；可以作为 skill 文本迁移存在上限的证据。

papers.name: SkillProbe
papers.title: One Skill, Many Models: Learning Representation Compatibility from Sparse Behavioral Tests
papers.summary: A budgeted framework that diagnoses model-specific preferences over semantically equivalent skill representations before adaptation, using a bank of 156 matched probes over 14 instruction and executable factors and a hierarchical Bayesian profile to choose the next probe.
papers.summary_zh: 一个有预算约束的框架，在适配之前诊断各模型对语义等价的 skill 写法的偏好：probe 库有 156 个配对的 probe，覆盖 14 个指令和可执行结构的因素，用分层贝叶斯画像挑选下一个 probe。

papers.name: Skill Transfer
papers.title: Skill Transfer: Adapting Agent Skills from Strong to Weak Agents
papers.summary: Hypothesizes that a strong model silently supplies procedural steps that a skill leaves implicit and that a weak model omits, and formalizes closing this gap when adapting skills from strong to weak agents.
papers.summary_zh: 提出假设：强模型会默默补上 skill 里没写明的过程步骤，而弱模型会漏掉；论文把从强 agent 到弱 agent 适配 skill 时补上这一差距的问题形式化。

papers.name: CMRF
papers.title: Cross-Model Reproductive Fitness: Evolving Transferable Skills across Model Hosts
papers.summary: A transfer-aware evolutionary framework that evaluates skills on heterogeneous model–harness configurations during evolution, instead of optimizing on one primary host and measuring transfer afterwards.
papers.summary_zh: 一个考虑迁移的进化框架：在进化过程中就在异构的模型与 harness 组合上评估 skill，而不是先在一个主模型上优化、事后再测迁移。

papers.name: HEIRS
papers.title: Beyond the Final Skill: Revaluing Skill Evolution History After Executor Replacement
papers.summary: Keeps the history of skill versions produced by evolution and, when the executor model is replaced, selects one unchanged archived version through target-side screening and confirmation.
papers.summary_zh: 保留进化过程中产生的各个 skill 版本；执行模型更换之后，通过目标侧的筛选和确认，从存档里原样选出一个版本使用。

papers.name: COBRA-Skills
papers.title: COBRA-Skills: Contextual Bandit-Guided Evolution for Agent Skill Optimization
papers.summary: Formulates skill optimization as budgeted sequential optimization over an evolving candidate space, using contextual-bandit prioritization to decide which candidates receive costly execution-based evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 优化写成在不断变化的候选空间上的有预算序贯优化，用 contextual bandit 决定把代价高的执行评测分配给哪些候选。

papers.name: SkillNEO
papers.title: SkillNEO: Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization of Agent Skills
papers.summary: Argues that a partially repaired skill can stay low-scoring until later edits land, and introduces non-elitist evolutionary optimization that keeps developing intermediate versions using comparative execution evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 指出修到一半的 skill 在后续修改完成之前可能一直得分偏低，因此提出非精英的进化优化，利用对比式的执行证据继续发展中间版本。

papers.name: Understanding Agent Skills
papers.title: Understanding Agent Skills: How Well Do They Transfer to Smaller Models?
papers.summary: An empirical study across skill-generation frameworks and model families of whether skills developed by frontier models help much smaller agents; strong-model skills do not consistently improve them.
papers.summary_zh: 一项实证研究，跨多个 skill 生成框架和模型家族，考察前沿模型产出的 skill 能不能帮到小得多的 agent；结论是强模型的 skill 并不能稳定地带来提升。

papers.name: SkillsBench-Compose
papers.title: When Skills Fail to Compose: Benchmarking and Compiling Agent Skills
papers.summary: A benchmark of 20 human-authored tasks that scores component requirements and cross-component relationships separately to expose failures in combining individually successful skills, with SkillCompiler compiling the supplied skills into one task-specific package.
papers.summary_zh: 一个包含 20 个人工编写任务的基准，把各组件的要求和组件之间的关系分开打分，暴露出单独可用的 skill 组合起来失败的情况；同时提出 SkillCompiler，把给定的 skill 编译成一份针对任务的包。

papers.name: Work2Skill
papers.title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
papers.summary: Captures human desktop GUI demonstrations with a recorder that aligns screen video, mouse and keyboard events, and accessibility-tree information, releases a dataset of 350 demonstrations, and induces reusable skills (workflow rules, step dependencies, completion checks) with an agent that inspects the evidence on demand.
papers.summary_zh: 用一个对齐屏幕录像、鼠标键盘事件和 accessibility tree 信息的录制工具采集人在桌面 GUI 上的演示，发布 350 条演示的数据集，并由一个按需查看证据的 agent 归纳出包含 workflow 规则、步骤依赖和完成检查的可复用 skill。

papers.name: SkillDreamer
papers.title: Imagine Before Acting: Prospective Skill Identification for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Observes that task descriptions state objectives while skill documents describe capabilities and procedures, a mismatch that causes useful skills to be missed in retrieval or invocation; it first imagines the required capabilities as pseudo skills to guide retrieval, then re-evaluates which skills to invoke as subtasks emerge during execution.
papers.summary_zh: 指出任务描述写的是目标、skill 文档写的是能力和流程，这种不对齐会让合适的 skill 在检索或调用时被漏掉；做法是先把执行所需的能力想象成 pseudo skill 来引导检索，执行过程中再随新出现的子任务重新判断该调用哪些 skill。

papers.name: SkillMorph
papers.title: Trajectory-Guided Fault Localization for Agent Skill Evolution
papers.summary: Links execution evidence to specific skill content before revising it: contrasts failure and success evidence in abstracted trajectories across repeated runs and tasks to identify suspicious actions, then uses them to localize edit sites in the skill and generate revisions; evaluated on SWE-Skills-Bench and CannBot.
papers.summary_zh: 先把执行证据对应到具体的 skill 内容再做修改：在多次运行、多个任务的抽象轨迹里对比失败和成功的证据，找出可疑动作，再据此定位 skill 里要改的位置并生成修改；在 SWE-Skills-Bench 和 CannBot 上评测。

papers.name: SkillContrast
papers.title: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking
papers.summary: A training-free text selector for skill reranking that compares the retrieved skills with one another and passes the passages where they differ, with local context, to a pretrained reranker, so that similar skills with different conditions of use stay distinguishable under a short input budget.
papers.summary_zh: 一个免训练的文本选择器，用于 skill 重排序：把检索到的 skill 互相比较，将它们有差异的段落连同局部上下文交给预训练的 reranker，使写法相近但适用条件不同的 skill 在较短的输入长度下仍能被区分。

papers.name: One Skill Too Many
papers.title: One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents
papers.summary: An empirical study of conflicts between co-installed skills that do the same job in coding agents, mined from snapshots of 20,947 repositories and run on 312 confirmed pairs across three models: a similar skill can run in place of the installed one and drop its core functions while the task still passes.
papers.summary_zh: 对编程 agent 中同时安装、功能相同的 skill 之间的冲突做实证研究：从 20,947 个仓库的快照中挖掘，在三个模型上运行 312 对确认的 skill；相似的 skill 可能顶替已安装的那个并丢掉它的核心功能，而任务仍然通过。

papers.name: SameCapRisk-Bench
papers.title: Right Family, Wrong Skill: Evaluating Risk Exposure in Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.summary: A skill-retrieval benchmark of 890 units and 1,314 query cases in which each unit pairs a skill that meets a query requirement with a same-capability skill that violates it, scoring retrievers and rerankers on both helpful hits and exposure of the conflicting sibling.
papers.summary_zh: 一个 skill 检索基准，包含 890 个单元和 1,314 个查询用例；每个单元把满足查询要求的 skill 和一个能力相同但违反该要求的 skill 配成一对，同时考察检索器和 reranker 命中有用 skill 的情况以及把冲突 skill 暴露给 agent 的情况。

papers.name: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills' Downstream Utility
papers.title: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills' Downstream Utility
papers.summary: Defines downstream utility as the pass-rate difference from a no-skill run under the same model–harness configuration and measures it on the 87 SkillsBench tasks across nine configurations, also examining alternative marketplace skills and multi-skill organization; the same skills help some configurations and hurt others on 36.78% of tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 把下游效用定义为同一模型与 harness 配置下相对无 skill 运行的通过率差值，在 SkillsBench 的 87 个任务、九种配置上测量，并考察 marketplace 里的替代 skill 和多个 skill 的组织方式；在 36.78% 的任务上，同一批 skill 对一些配置有益、对另一些有害。

papers.name: TeleTune
papers.title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
papers.summary: Learns a textual skill library from offline usage logs that record no goals, cannot be replayed, and may interleave tasks: action-prediction errors on logged trajectories propose library edits, and an edit is kept only if it improves held-out action-prediction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: 从离线使用日志中学习文本形式的 skill 库，这些日志没有记录目标、不能重放、还可能把多个任务混在一起：用日志轨迹上的动作预测误差提出对 skill 库的修改，只保留能提高 held-out 动作预测准确率的修改。

papers.name: Mining Agent Skills from Production Traces
papers.title: Mining Agent Skills from Production Traces
papers.summary: Holding the mining pipeline fixed, compares three levels of mining evidence (successful trajectories only, successes and failures with outcome labels, the same mix with labels withheld) and two skill forms (ordered workflow plan, declarative ontology) on two enterprise benchmarks; which combination helps depends on the domain.
papers.summary_zh: 在挖掘流程固定的前提下，比较三种挖掘证据（只用成功轨迹、带结果标签的成功与失败轨迹、去掉标签的同一批轨迹）和两种 skill 形式（有序的 workflow 计划、声明式的 ontology），在两个企业场景基准上评测；哪种组合有效取决于领域。

papers.name: Defense-as-Skill
papers.title: Defense-as-Skill: Evolving Runtime Guard Skill for Skill-Augmented Agents
papers.summary: Implements a runtime guard against malicious skills as an installable, editable skill that checks sensitive actions against the user's task boundary, and improves the guard skill with a Monte-Carlo tree search driven by rollout feedback; listed here as a case of evolving a skill toward a safety objective.
papers.summary_zh: 把防御恶意 skill 的运行时 guard 本身做成一个可安装、可编辑的 skill，按用户任务的边界检查敏感动作，并用由 rollout 反馈驱动的 Monte-Carlo tree search 改进这个 guard skill；收在这里是因为它是以安全为目标进化 skill 的例子。

papers.name: Skill-V
papers.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
papers.summary: Represents skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that tie semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria: task failures trigger skill addition, disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes trigger revisions of skill boundaries, and revisions must pass non-regression checks on replayed historical evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 表示成带版本、可证伪的契约，将语义意图和可观察的行为标准对应起来：任务失败触发新增 skill，契约评估和任务结果不一致时触发对 skill 边界的修订，修订必须在重放的历史证据上通过不退化检查。

papers.name: Skill Misevolution
papers.title: Practice Makes Unsafe: Skill Misevolution in Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.summary: Shows that skill evolution can keep an unsafe procedure inside an otherwise useful skill so that later benign tasks repeat the harm, builds a gym and a 525-task benchmark that check the writing and retrieval steps separately, and proposes SafeEvolve, which checks a skill both when it is written and when a later task retrieves it.
papers.summary_zh: 说明 skill 进化可能把不安全的流程留在一个本身有用的 skill 里，让之后的良性任务重复这一危害；构建了能分别检查写入和检索两个环节的 gym 和一个 525 个任务的基准，并提出 SafeEvolve，在 skill 写入时和被后续任务检索时各检查一次。

papers.name: SkillEvoLean
papers.title: SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers
papers.summary: Skill self-evolution for Lean theorem provers that jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge: progressive updates draw on successful and failed trajectories, and when no complete proof can be generated a mutation step samples mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback.
papers.summary_zh: 面向 Lean 定理证明器的 skill 自进化，同时进化高层解题策略和它的参考知识：渐进式更新利用成功和失败的轨迹；当生成不出完整证明时，变异步骤通过采样数学概念产生新的 skill 候选，并在 verifier 反馈下选择。

papers.name: Do Self-Evolving Skills Generalize to Held-Out Tasks?
papers.title: Do Self-Evolving Skills Generalize to Held-Out Tasks?
papers.summary: Tests five self-evolving skill methods and a one-shot skill on six benchmarks with the same model, agent, and train/test split: of the 21 skills that improve on their training tasks, 5 keep all of that improvement on test tasks, 13 keep part, and 3 keep none; also describes GSO, which keeps only a skill-writing guide and writes a new skill for each task.
papers.summary_zh: 在六个基准上用相同的模型、agent 和训练/测试划分测试五种 skill 自进化方法和一个一次性生成的 skill：在训练任务上有提升的 21 个 skill 中，5 个在测试任务上保住了全部提升，13 个保住一部分，3 个完全没有保住；同时给出 GSO，只保留一份写 skill 的指南，对每个任务新写一个 skill。

papers.name: EconSkills
papers.title: EconSkills: Studying Skill Transfer and Retrieval for Web Agents on Live Economic Data
papers.summary: A skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures, and separates two questions: whether a known relevant procedure transfers to a held-out task, and whether that benefit survives when the agent selects from a 50-skill library.
papers.summary_zh: 一个 skill 库和评测框架，把经过验证的 EconWebArena 轨迹蒸馏成参数化的标准操作流程，并把两个问题分开考察：已知相关的流程能否迁移到 held-out 任务，以及 agent 从 50 个 skill 的库里自行选择时这一收益能否保住。

papers.name: MOCHA
papers.title: MOCHA: Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing for Agent Skill Optimization
papers.summary: Treats skill optimization as multi-objective (accuracy and the context cost of fields such as the description and instruction body), selecting skills to improve by Chebyshev scalarization with random weights and accepting edits that expand the Pareto front while annealing from exploration to exploitation.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 优化看作多目标问题（准确率，以及 description、正文等字段占用的上下文成本），用随机权重的 Chebyshev 标量化挑选待改进的 skill，接受能扩展 Pareto 前沿的修改，并从探索逐步退火到利用。

papers.name: SkillCommit
papers.title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
papers.summary: Stores each experience first as an instance-specific patch and abstracts patches into a higher-level skill only when cross-instance replay and an LLM mechanism check show a shared behavioral mechanism and the abstraction preserves every constituent's validated behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 先把每条经验存成针对具体实例的 patch，只有当跨实例重放和 LLM 机制检查都表明它们共享同一行为机制、且抽象后的 skill 保留每个组成部分已验证的行为时，才合并成更高层的 skill。

papers.name: AtomSearch
papers.title: AtomSearch: Evidence-Grounded Tree Search for Agent Skill Optimization
papers.summary: Revises skills through atomic rule edits, each tied to contrasting failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, and an intended scope, and searches a tree of skill states that keeps short edit compositions revisitable, with an outcome memory of past repairs and regressions.
papers.summary_zh: 用原子化的规则修改修订 skill，每次修改都关联到对比的失败与成功执行、一个行为假设和预期作用范围；在 skill 状态树上搜索，保留可回溯、可扩展的短修改组合，并用结果记忆记录以往的修复与退化。

papers.name: Emotion2Skill
papers.title: Emotion2Skill: Model-Internal Emotion Signals for Adaptive Skill Selection and Evolution
papers.summary: Extracts emotion vectors from the LLM's internal representations and uses them both to choose skills and to flag problematic invocations for targeted skill refinement; evaluated on WebShop and ALFWorld.
papers.summary_zh: 从 LLM 内部表示中提取情绪向量，既用于选择 skill，也用来标记有问题的调用，以便有针对性地修订 skill；在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上评测。

papers.name: Socratic Skill Learning
papers.title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
papers.summary: Interleaves an Educator's guidance with a Student's own practice, with the Student remaining the only environment operator and skill author, and introduces SkillTransferBench to test whether learned skills hold up in fresh solver sessions on held-out variations.
papers.summary_zh: 让 Educator 的指导与 Student 的实践交替进行，Student 始终是唯一操作环境、撰写 skill 的一方；同时提出 SkillTransferBench，检验学到的 skill 在全新求解会话、留出变体上是否仍然有效。

papers.name: SkillEval
papers.title: SkillEval: Decomposing Agent Skill Quality into Interpretable Signals
papers.summary: Scores general properties of a SKILL.md document along fixed, interpretable directions while reducing the influence of unrelated document features, and uses the scores as an early signal of downstream effectiveness and to guide targeted revisions.
papers.summary_zh: 对 SKILL.md 文档的通用属性给出方向固定、可解释的评分，并降低无关文档特征的干扰；这些分数可作为下游效果的早期信号，也用于指导有针对性的修订。

papers.name: Skill-α
papers.title: Progressive Agent Skill Generation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Learns one RL policy that builds a skill by editing it step by step over successive source evidence, from documents or experience, rewarding each edit by comparing downstream execution under the original and edited skill on an anchored query.
papers.summary_zh: 用 RL 学习一个统一的策略，依次读取文档或经验中的证据、逐步编辑出 skill；每次编辑的奖励来自在锚定 query 上比较原 skill 与修改后 skill 的下游执行结果。

papers.name: Cortex
papers.title: Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
papers.summary: Turns developer corrections to a coding agent into replayable tasks and adds or deletes one skill or rule at a time, keeping a change only if repeated runs with and without it show a net gain and no task gets noticeably worse; evaluated with Claude Haiku 4.5 on a purpose-built repository.
papers.summary_zh: 把开发者对 coding agent 的纠正保存为可重放的任务，每次只新增或删除一条 skill 或规则，只有在有无它的多次重复运行显示净收益、且没有任务明显变差时才保留；在专门构建的仓库上用 Claude Haiku 4.5 评测。

papers.name: ContinualSkillBench
papers.title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
papers.summary: A benchmark for in-context continual skill learning with five domains of difficulty-ordered tasks; it finds that keeping context and feedback without explicit skill maintenance performs about as well on average as maintaining a skill library, with selective benefits for reusable procedures or precise outputs.
papers.summary_zh: 一个面向上下文内持续 skill 学习的基准，含五个领域、按难度排序的任务；发现只保留上下文和反馈、不维护显式 skill 库时，平均表现与维护 skill 库相当，显式 skill 只在需要可复用流程或精确输出的任务上有选择性收益。

papers.name: WER
papers.title: Write, Execute, Refine: From Skill Follower to Skill Optimizer via Reinforcement Learning from Execution Feedback
papers.summary: Trains a skill optimizer outside a frozen executor with group-relative rewards from verified repeated executions, turning matched successful and failed trajectories into the next phase's refinement states; evaluated on BFCL v4 multi-turn and tau2-bench.
papers.summary_zh: 在冻结的执行 agent 之外训练一个 skill 优化器：以多次执行的验证结果作为组内相对奖励，并把配对的成功与失败轨迹作为下一阶段的修订输入；在 BFCL v4 多轮和 tau2-bench 上评测。

papers.name: Skill Inconsistencies at Runtime
papers.title: Why Static Skill Inconsistencies Do Not Equate to Runtime Risks: A Behavioral Analysis of LLM Agent Execution
papers.summary: Audits community and benchmark skill packages for conflicts among documentation, scripts, and configuration files, then compares no-skill, original-skill, and fixed-skill runs to measure how much these static defects actually change agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 审计社区和基准 skill 包中文档、脚本与配置文件之间的冲突，再比较无 skill、原 skill、修复后 skill 三种设置下的执行，衡量这些静态缺陷实际在多大程度上改变 agent 行为。

papers.name: RSIPO
papers.title: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
papers.summary: Co-evolves skills and the policy model during agentic RL: the policy extracts skills from its own completed trajectories and is trained on that ability through trajectory replay, while empirical Bayes shrinkage calibrates how much the student trusts skill-conditioned teacher scores.
papers.summary_zh: 在 agentic RL 中让 skill 与策略模型共同进化：策略从自己完成的轨迹中提炼 skill，并通过轨迹重放训练这一能力；同时用经验贝叶斯收缩调节学生对以 skill 为条件的教师打分的信任程度。

papers.name: SKT
papers.title: SKT: Skill-Use Training at Scale via Verified Synthetic Data Generation
papers.summary: A verified data-synthesis pipeline that builds single- and multi-skill tasks from public agent skills and keeps only executable trajectories that substantially use every required skill, for supervised fine-tuning of skill use; it also releases a held-out skill-use benchmark.
papers.summary_zh: 一个经过验证的数据合成流程：从公开 agent skill 构造单 skill 和多 skill 任务，只保留实际用到全部所需 skill 的可执行轨迹，用于监督微调模型的 skill 使用能力；同时发布一个留出的 skill 使用基准。

papers.name: Skill-R1
papers.title: Skill-R1: Agent Skill Evolution via Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Trains a lightweight skill generator, conditioned on task context, prior rollouts, and verified outcomes, to revise skills for a frozen task LLM over several generations, using a bi-level GRPO objective with intra- and inter-generation advantages.
papers.summary_zh: 训练一个轻量的 skill 生成器，以任务上下文、先前 rollout 和验证结果为条件，在多代中为冻结的任务 LLM 修订 skill；优化目标是带代内与代间优势的双层 GRPO。

papers.name: SkillCraft
papers.title: SkillCraft: Skill-Set Retrieval Beyond Ranking for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Recasts post-retrieval skill selection as set resolution rather than ranking, estimating non-monotonic membership probabilities from list-relative evidence so that high-ranked distractors can be skipped, with set-level calibration deciding how many skills to admit.
papers.summary_zh: 把检索后的 skill 选择从排序问题改为集合判定问题：基于列表内的相对证据估计非单调的成员概率，从而跳过排名靠前的干扰项，并用集合层面的校准决定纳入多少个 skill。

papers.name: Skill-SP
papers.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
papers.summary: Couples a task proposer, an RL-trained solver, and a skill controller in a self-play loop, where sampled skills condition task generation and execution feedback updates and expands the skill library.
papers.summary_zh: 把任务生成器、用强化学习训练的求解器和 skill 控制器放进同一个 self-play 循环：按采样到的 skill 生成任务，再用执行反馈更新和扩充 skill 库。

papers.name: MetaCascade
papers.title: MetaCascade: End-to-End Attacks on Agent Skills via Metadata-Only Poisoning
papers.summary: An end-to-end attack that poisons only skill metadata, expanding malicious candidates and iteratively optimizing their metadata with black-box competition feedback so the target skill survives retrieval and selection.
papers.summary_zh: 一种只篡改 skill 元数据的端到端攻击：先扩展出多个恶意候选，再用黑盒竞争反馈迭代优化元数据，使目标 skill 在检索和选择两步都能胜出。

papers.name: SkillFlow
papers.title: SkillFlow: Scalable and Efficient Agent Skill Retrieval System
papers.summary: Treats skill acquisition as multi-stage retrieval over about 35K community SKILL.md files (dense retrieval, two cross-encoder reranking rounds, LLM selection), and finds that retrieval only helps when the corpus has executable skills for the target domain.
papers.summary_zh: 把获取 skill 看作在约 3.5 万个社区 SKILL.md 上的多阶段检索（稠密检索、两轮 cross-encoder 重排、LLM 选择），并发现只有语料里有目标领域可执行的 skill 时检索才有收益。

papers.name: SkillLens
papers.title: SkillLens: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Skill Reuse for Cost-Efficient LLM Agents
papers.summary: Organizes skills as a four-layer graph of policies, strategies, procedures, and primitives, retrieves them at mixed granularity via random walks, and uses a verifier to accept, decompose, rewrite, or skip each unit while both skills and verifier are refined over time.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 组织成策略、方略、流程、原语四层图，用随机游走按混合粒度检索，由 verifier 决定每个单元是接受、分解、改写还是跳过，skill 和 verifier 都随时间迭代。

papers.name: Proteus
papers.title: Proteus: A Self-Evolving Red Team for Agent Skill Ecosystems
papers.summary: A grey-box self-evolving red team that repeatedly rewrites malicious skills using audit findings and sandbox runtime evidence, measuring how far budgeted adaptive attackers get past skill vetting.
papers.summary_zh: 一个灰盒的自演化红队框架，根据审计结果和沙箱运行证据反复改写恶意 skill，用来度量有预算的自适应攻击者能多大程度绕过 skill 审核。

papers.name: VideoWeaver
papers.title: VideoWeaver: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Agentic Long Video Generation
papers.summary: An agent harness and benchmark for long video generation in which an agent composes foundation skills into its own workflow and an evolution algorithm refines composition and creator skills using agent-as-judge feedback.
papers.summary_zh: 面向长视频生成的 agent harness 和基准：agent 自行把基础 skill 组合成工作流，演化算法再依据 agent-as-judge 的反馈改进组合类和创作类 skill。

papers.name: SelfEvoSkill
papers.title: SelfEvoSkill: Paired Execution Audits for Skill Revision without External Outcome Supervision
papers.summary: Revises skills without task rewards by comparing matched executions with and without the skill, tracing behavioral differences to specific skill passages and re-evaluating the revised passages.
papers.summary_zh: 不依赖任务奖励修订 skill：对比同一任务在有无该 skill 时的配对执行，把行为差异定位到具体段落，修改后再重新执行评估。

papers.name: Shortening Skills
papers.title: Shortening agent skills leaves LLM agent cost unchanged
papers.summary: An empirical study on SkillsBench showing that compressing, LLM-rewriting, or partially loading curated skills does not reduce per-task cost, and that LLM rewriting can lower success on a small model.
papers.summary_zh: 在 SkillsBench 上的实证研究：对精选 skill 做压缩、用 LLM 改写或部分加载都没有降低单任务成本，LLM 改写还会降低小模型的成功率。

papers.name: SIGIL
papers.title: SIGIL: Skill Compilation for Reliable and Efficient Agent Execution
papers.summary: Compiles an authored skill and its resources into a typed, validated intermediate representation and deterministically generates an executable harness, leaving only the decisions the skill delegates to the model.
papers.summary_zh: 把编写好的 skill 及其资源编译成带类型、经过校验的中间表示，再确定性地生成可执行的 harness，只把 skill 原本交给模型的决策留给模型。

papers.name: SkillBloat
papers.title: SkillBloat: Token Amplification Attacks via Skill Injection in LLM Coding Agents
papers.summary: A token-amplification attack via malicious skills that first screens attack types across amplification mechanisms and then refines the strongest candidate by LLM-guided full-document skill rewriting.
papers.summary_zh: 通过恶意 skill 放大 token 消耗的攻击：先在多种放大机制上筛选攻击类型，再用 LLM 引导的整篇 skill 改写细化最强的候选。

papers.name: SkillGym
papers.title: SkillGym: Internalizing Human Skills into LLMs for Real-World Problem Solving
papers.summary: Turns human-written agent skills into verifiable training environments with code-based checkers and collects trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and outcome-reward RL that internalize the skills into model weights.
papers.summary_zh: 把人写的 agent skill 转成带代码检查器的可验证训练环境，收集轨迹用于监督微调和基于结果奖励的强化学习，把 skill 内化进模型权重。

papers.name: SkillPivot
papers.title: A Wrong Turn Does Not Ruin the Journey: Deviation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Locates the point where a failed trajectory turns from a useful prefix into an erroneous suffix, has a stronger teacher continue from that prefix, and contrasts the two suffixes to produce localized skill updates.
papers.summary_zh: 找出失败轨迹从有用前缀转为错误后缀的位置，让更强的教师模型从该前缀继续执行，再对比两段后缀生成局部的 skill 更新。

papers.name: Smart Contract Audit Skills
papers.title: Demystifying Agent Skills for Smart Contract Auditing: Design, Effectiveness, Behavioral Impact
papers.summary: Collects 83 in-the-wild smart-contract audit skills and evaluates their design, effectiveness, and influence on agent trajectories on EVMBench across seven agent-model configurations, identifying skill triggering as a key bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh: 收集 83 个真实环境中的智能合约审计 skill，在 EVMBench 上跨七种 agent 与模型组合评估其设计、效果和对执行轨迹的影响，发现 skill 能否被触发是主要瓶颈。

papers.name: Plugin Migration Skill Study
papers.title: Evaluating Agent Skills for Version-Specific Plugin Migration: A Retrospective Study
papers.summary: A retrospective evaluation of a shipped plugin-upgrade skill that traces each grading decision to the target version contract, exposing grader errors and judge sensitivity behind the measured skill gain.
papers.summary_zh: 对一个已发布的插件升级 skill 做回顾性评估，把每个评分决定追溯到目标版本的契约，揭示 skill 增益背后的评分错误和对评审模型的敏感性。

papers.name: HEXIS
papers.title: HEXIS: Compiling Agent Skills into Extended Finite State Machines
papers.summary: Compiles agent skills into extended finite state machines that separate skill knowledge from control flow, incrementally adding or refining states from development traces and accepting updates only after static checks and trace replay.
papers.summary_zh: 把 agent skill 编译成扩展有限状态机，将 skill 知识与控制流分离；根据开发轨迹增量添加或细化状态，更新须通过静态检查和轨迹回放才被接受。

papers.name: SkillEvoReg
papers.title: SkillEvoReg: Regularizing Agent Skill Evolution Against Overfitting
papers.summary: Frames repeated skill updates as a learning process prone to overfitting and regularizes it with skill dropout during update generation, complexity-aware local regularization, and causal counterexample validation.
papers.summary_zh: 把反复的 skill 更新视为会过拟合的学习过程，用更新生成时的 skill dropout、考虑复杂度的局部正则和因果反例验证来加以约束。

papers.name: MammoClaw
papers.title: MammoClaw: Towards Skill-Evolving Agent Harness for Breast Cancer Mammography Analysis
papers.summary: A training-free mammography agent on frozen MLLMs with region and paired-view tools, where skill evolution turns failed trajectories into reusable guidance for later runs.
papers.summary_zh: 基于冻结 MLLM、不需训练的乳腺 X 线分析 agent，配有区域和双视图检查工具，通过 skill 演化把失败轨迹转成后续可复用的指导。

papers.name: SkillDelta
papers.title: When Does a Skill Add Value? Task-Conditional Gain Prediction for Selective Skill Use
papers.summary: Predicts whether a skill will help on a given task from paired with- and without-skill executions of the same agent, and uses a local predictor to decide when to activate skills on new tasks without retraining the agent.
papers.summary_zh: 基于同一 agent 有无 skill 的配对执行，预测某个 skill 在具体任务上是否有益，并用局部预测器决定在新任务上何时启用 skill，无需重新训练 agent。

papers.name: SkillDRE
papers.title: SkillDRE: Dual-Stage Red-Team Evolution of Agent Skills via Pre-Execution and Runtime Feedback
papers.summary: Evolves complete malicious skill packages through a closed loop that alternates scanner-guided evolution and runtime-guided refinement under defenses while preserving benign-task capability.
papers.summary_zh: 通过闭环演化完整的恶意 skill 包：交替进行扫描器反馈引导的演化和防御下运行反馈引导的细化，同时保留正常任务能力。

papers.name: ExpVoyager
papers.title: ExpVoyager: Direct Experience Navigation for Dynamic Agent Skill Synthesis
papers.summary: Reframes skill synthesis as on-demand navigation over raw past trajectories, with a skill curator exploring experience at different views and resolutions for the current task instead of abstracting it in advance.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 合成改为按需在原始历史轨迹中导航：skill 整理器针对当前任务以不同视角和粒度探索经验，而不是预先抽象成固定知识。

papers.name: SkillVine
papers.title: SkillVine: Agent Skill Evolution via Branching Exploration
papers.summary: Formulates skill-library evolution as graph search with trunk-branch exploration, a parent-node selector, and adaptive-granularity updates, rather than applying edits linearly to the latest version.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 库演化表述为图搜索，采用主干与分支协同探索、父节点选择器和自适应粒度的更新，而不是只在最新版本上线性修改。

papers.name: VALVE
papers.title: Certified Long-Horizon Code Agent Evolution via Validation-Gated Skill Optimization
papers.summary: A validation-gated framework for long-horizon text skill optimization on streams of repository-level software tasks, with guarantees on convergence, future-task gain, and drawdown.
papers.summary_zh: 一个带验证门控的长时程文本 skill 优化框架，面向仓库级软件任务流，给出收敛、后续任务收益和回撤的理论保证。

papers.name: R² Flow
papers.title: R$^2$ Flow: Recursive Self-Improvement via Recursive Skill Evolution
papers.summary: Alternates flow-based policy learning over a shared-state orchestration graph, independent verification, and versioned skill-library edits, using flow-share and signed utility to decide which skills to change.
papers.summary_zh: 在共享状态的编排图上交替进行基于 flow 的策略学习、独立验证和带版本的 skill 库修改，用 flow 份额和带符号的效用决定改哪些 skill。

papers.name: SkillFocus
papers.title: SkillFocus: Evolving Agent Skills via Capability Decomposition
papers.summary: Decomposes recurring task requirements into a fixed capability space, then picks the capability leaving the most tasks unresolved to decide what to revise in a skill and which evidence to use.
papers.summary_zh: 把反复出现的任务要求分解成固定的能力空间，选出使最多任务未解决的能力，据此决定修订 skill 的哪部分以及使用哪些证据。

papers.name: V-Gym
papers.title: V-Gym: Enhancing Agentic Visual Reasoning via Skill-Data Co-Evolution
papers.summary: Co-evolves hierarchical procedural skills and multimodal practice data from execution trajectories, keeping a skill update only if it improves validation performance.
papers.summary_zh: 从执行轨迹出发，同时演化分层的流程性 skill 和多模态练习数据，skill 更新只有在提升验证集表现时才保留。

papers.name: RSI-Router
papers.title: RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents
papers.summary: Builds subtask-level routing between a large and a small model together with model-specific skills through recursive self-improvement, keeping a Pareto population of routers.
papers.summary_zh: 通过递归自我改进同时构建大小模型之间子任务级的路由和针对各模型的 skill，并维护路由方案的 Pareto 种群。

papers.name: Progressive Disclosure
papers.title: Report: Progressive Disclosure of Agent Skills
papers.summary: An industry report measuring how lazy-loading skills in deployed agents affects skill-retrieval quality and overall latency as the skill library grows.
papers.summary_zh: 一份工业界报告，测量在已部署的 agent 中按需加载 skill 对检索质量和整体延迟的影响。

papers.name: SSPE
papers.title: Semantic Projection for Continual Self-Evolution of Language Agents
papers.summary: Transfers the idea of orthogonal gradient projection to natural-language skill revision, building a revision that avoids interfering with previously acquired capabilities when one shared skill evolves over a non-stationary task stream.
papers.summary_zh: 把正交梯度投影的思路迁移到自然语言 skill 修订：共享的 skill 在非平稳任务流上演化时，构造不干扰已有能力的修订。

papers.name: EASE
papers.title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.summary: Trains a single RL skill curator, conditioned on an online profile of the executor’s behavior, to add, modify, or remove skills for different frozen executors without per-executor fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh: 用强化学习训练一个统一的 skill 整理器，以执行模型行为的在线画像为条件，为不同的冻结执行模型增删改 skill，无需逐模型微调。

papers.name: SkillCome
papers.title: SkillCome: Group Contrast Skill Optimization with Dual Memory
papers.summary: Generates groups of trajectories per question, contrasts successful and failed ones to locate key divergences, and accumulates evidence in a dual memory to stabilize skill edits.
papers.summary_zh: 对每个问题生成一组轨迹，对比成功与失败轨迹找出关键分歧，并用双重记忆累积历史证据，使 skill 修改方向更稳定。

papers.name: RASO
papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation
papers.summary: Uses an external corpus of public skills as a prior for skill optimization, retrieving and adapting relevant skills across domain and harness mismatches for both initialization and feedback-guided updates.
papers.summary_zh: 把公开的 skill 语料作为 skill 优化的先验，在初始化和反馈驱动的更新两个阶段检索相关 skill，并针对领域与 harness 的差异做适配。

papers.name: Prompt2Skill
papers.title: Prompt2Skill: Unsupervised Skill Optimization From Natural Language Instructions
papers.summary: Builds a skill from a natural-language task description alone by deriving a task specification, discovering or synthesizing data, and refining the skill through reflective editing.
papers.summary_zh: 只凭自然语言任务描述构建 skill：先推出任务规格、寻找或合成数据，再通过反思式编辑迭代改进 skill。

papers.name: SkillSeek
papers.title: SkillSeek: Revisiting Agent Skill Retrieval at Marketplace Scale
papers.summary: An open-source two-stage skill retriever (bi-encoder plus small cross-encoder over MCP) that reaches parity with LLM-mediated retrieval loops on SkillsBench at much lower cost.
papers.summary_zh: 一个开源的两阶段 skill 检索器（双塔编码器加小型 cross-encoder，通过 MCP 提供），在 SkillsBench 上以低得多的成本达到与 LLM 介导的检索循环相当的效果。

papers.name: Rep2Skill
papers.title: Rep2Skill: Representation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Uses the agent’s internal representation trajectories to localize turns that deviate from successful execution and turns these signals into textual feedback for targeted skill revision.
papers.summary_zh: 利用 agent 内部表示的轨迹定位偏离成功执行的轮次，再把这些信号转成文本反馈用于有针对性的 skill 修订。

papers.name: EngramBench
papers.title: EngramBench: A Capability-Grounded Benchmark for Skill-Evolution Harnesses
papers.summary: A benchmark for skill-evolution harnesses that requires capability overlap without solution overlap between learning and transfer tasks, separating capability abstraction from solution leakage.
papers.summary_zh: 一个面向 skill 演化 harness 的基准，要求学习任务与迁移任务能力重叠而解法不重叠，以区分能力抽象和解法泄漏。

papers.name: SkillSpec
papers.title: SkillSpec: Consensus-Gated Agent Skill Evolution via Representation Specialization
papers.summary: Commits skill edits only when paired evaluations reach consensus, then uses signals from the optimization trajectory to choose a flat, graph, or hybrid skill representation.
papers.summary_zh: 只有在配对评估达成一致时才提交 skill 修改，之后再依据整个优化轨迹的信号为 skill 选择扁平、图或混合的表示。

papers.name: MCRI
papers.title: MCRI: A Four-Dimensional Framework for Analyzing and Evaluating Agent Skills
papers.summary: A four-dimensional framework and LLM-based evaluator for analyzing agent skills before execution, applied to a large public skill hub and used to prioritize skill selection.
papers.summary_zh: 一个四维的 agent skill 分析框架和基于 LLM 的评估方法，可在执行前评估 skill，应用于大规模公开 skill 库并用于 skill 选择。

papers.name: Process-Level Skill Evaluation
papers.title: Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills
papers.summary: A continuous evaluation framework for evolving enterprise agent skills that adds process-level checks of tool selection, arguments, ordering, and database state to final-output checks.
papers.summary_zh: 一个面向不断变化的企业级 agent skill 的持续评估框架，在最终输出检查之外加入工具选择、参数、执行顺序和数据库状态的过程级检查。

papers.name: SkillScriptBench
papers.title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
papers.summary: A benchmark that separately evaluates documentation repair, script repair, and preservation when revising executable skill packages, plus an AST-guided revision stage that links requirements to code locations.
papers.summary_zh: 一个分别评估可执行 skill 包的文档修复、脚本修复和行为保持的基准，并提出用抽象语法树把维护需求关联到代码位置的修订方法。

papers.name: Skill Revisions Study
papers.title: Agent Skill Evolution: How Revisions Affect Coding Agents
papers.summary: Characterizes how SKILL.md files are revised in open-source projects and measures how added or removed rules change compliance, action rates, correctness, and token cost across models and coding agents.
papers.summary_zh: 刻画开源项目中 SKILL.md 文件是如何被修订的，并测量增删规则对不同模型和 coding agent 的遵从度、动作执行率、正确性和 token 成本的影响。

papers.name: EVISKILL
papers.title: EVISKILL: Grounding Skill Evolution in Replayable Evidence
papers.summary: Organizes execution observations into replayable evidence cards linked to each skill edit, verifies edits by targeted replay, and provisionally retains supported edits before global validation decides incorporation.
papers.summary_zh: 把执行观测整理成可回放的证据卡并与每条 skill 修改关联，通过定向回放验证修改，先暂存有证据支持的修改，再由全局验证决定是否并入。

papers.name: Skill-in-Skill
papers.title: Skill-in-Skill: Agent Skills That Carry Their Own Execution Conditions Across Domains
papers.summary: A portable skill architecture that bundles activation, authorization, execution, and verification conditions with the skill itself, compared against keeping equivalent governance in an external sidecar under cross-boundary transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 一种可移植的 skill 架构，把激活、授权、执行和验证条件与 skill 打包在一起，并在跨边界迁移场景下与把同等治理放在外部 sidecar 的做法比较。

papers.name: SkillCore
papers.title: From Loading Skills to Knowing Them: Scaffolding-Removed Fine-Tuning for Agent Skill Internalization
papers.summary: A data pipeline and SFT recipe that removes skill-loading scaffolding from agent trajectories so generalizable skills are internalized into weights, mixing in skill-native trajectories to keep task-specific skill calls.
papers.summary_zh: 一个数据流程和监督微调方案：从 agent 轨迹中去掉加载 skill 的脚手架，使通用 skill 内化进权重，同时混入少量原生调用 skill 的轨迹以保留对任务专用 skill 的调用。

papers.name: JIT Skill Compilation
papers.title: Optimizing Agent Execution through Just-in-Time Skill Compilation
papers.summary: A just-in-time compiler that treats execution traces as profiles, compiles recurring deterministic segments into parameterized scripts delivered as a skill, and records and tests each script’s assumptions.
papers.summary_zh: 一个即时编译器：把执行轨迹当作 profiling 信息，将反复出现的确定性片段编译成参数化脚本并作为 skill 交付，同时记录并检验每个脚本的前提假设。

papers.name: CASU
papers.title: CASU: Case-to-Class Skill Synthesis with Adaptive Skill Utilization for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Distills trajectories into case-level and then class-level skills, and uses a skill absorption efficiency score to decide which skills to internalize by distillation and which to keep as external guidance.
papers.summary_zh: 把轨迹提炼成实例级再到类别级的 skill，并用 skill 吸收效率指标决定哪些 skill 通过蒸馏内化进参数、哪些保留为外部指导。

papers.name: SELM
papers.title: Selm: Self-Evolving Library Management for Multi-Skill Agent Optimization
papers.summary: Treats skill evolution as library-level management, combining utility-aware retrieval, Map-Reduce update generation from task experience, and lifecycle controls that retain or prune skills.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 演化看作库层面的管理，结合考虑效用的检索、基于任务经验的 Map-Reduce 式更新生成，以及保留或删除 skill 的生命周期控制。

papers.name: LCA-RLOO
papers.title: Lineage-Calibrated Evidence Aggregation for Sybil-Resistant Skill Evolution
papers.summary: Calibrates persistent skill updates using an execution-lineage graph so that trajectories sharing an upstream source are not counted as independent evidence, with root leave-one-out validation before admission.
papers.summary_zh: 利用执行谱系图校准持久 skill 的更新，避免把来自同一上游来源的轨迹当作独立证据，并在接纳前做按根节点留一的验证。

papers.name: ViSkill
papers.title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
papers.summary: Encodes successful interactions as visual skill cards for VLM agents, using retrieved skills for both inference and reward shaping while policy optimization and skill accumulation reinforce each other.
papers.summary_zh: 把成功交互编码成供 VLM agent 使用的视觉 skill 卡片，检索到的 skill 同时用于推理和奖励塑形，策略优化与 skill 积累相互促进。

papers.name: SkillFlow (orchestration)
papers.title: SkillFlow: Flow-Driven Recursive Skill Evolution for Agentic Orchestration
papers.summary: Trains an orchestration supervisor with a flow-matching trajectory-balance loss over a frozen executor and a dynamic skill library, and uses the resulting flow diagnostics to decide when and which skills to create or prune.
papers.summary_zh: 在冻结执行模型和动态 skill 库之上，用基于 flow matching 的轨迹平衡损失训练编排 supervisor，并依据 flow 诊断决定何时创建或删除哪些 skill。

papers.name: CoEvo-MAS
papers.title: CoEvo-MAS: Co-Evolving Skills and Agent Organizations in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: Co-evolves distilled skills and multi-agent organizations, summarizing skill usage into a profile that a meta agent uses to propose validated changes to skill assignments, roles, or composition.
papers.summary_zh: 同时演化提炼出的 skill 和多 agent 的组织结构：把 skill 使用情况汇总成画像，由 meta agent 据此提出 skill 分配、角色或组成的修改，并经验证后部署。

papers.name: VeriTree
papers.title: Verification as a Budget: Posterior-Separation Scheduling for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
papers.summary: Restructures the skill-optimization loop as a skill tree with uncertainty estimates, deciding each round between more validation and generating a new candidate by a posterior-separation criterion.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 优化的外层循环改成带不确定性估计的 skill 树，每一轮依据后验分离准则在追加验证和生成新候选之间做选择。

papers.name: SciSkillBank
papers.title: SciSkillBank: A Dataset of Claude Code Skills for Scientific Research
papers.summary: A dataset of research-relevant Claude Code skill repositories annotated by an LLM for research stage, methodological content, and human control, with tests of how stable the labels are across prompts and models.
papers.summary_zh: 一个与科研相关的 Claude Code skill 仓库数据集，由 LLM 按科研阶段、是否包含方法知识和人工控制程度标注，并检验标签在不同提问方式和模型下的稳定性。

papers.name: SPARK
papers.title: Evidence Over Plans: Online Trajectory Verification for Skill Distillation
papers.summary: A closed-loop skill synthesis framework that generates skills from environment-verified trajectories and uses a trajectory-level index of posterior evidence as an online signal to steer skill generation.
papers.summary_zh: 一个闭环的 skill 合成框架，从经环境验证的轨迹中生成 skill，并用衡量后验证据的轨迹级指标作为在线信号引导 skill 生成。

papers.name: PrivacySkills
papers.title: PrivacySkills: How Privacy Guidance Shapes Source Selection in LLM Agents
papers.summary: A controlled evaluation of how privacy guidance in system instructions versus skill-level metadata labels shapes which information sources agents choose.
papers.summary_zh: 一个受控评估框架，研究放在系统指令中和放在 skill 元数据标签中的隐私指导，分别如何影响 agent 对信息来源的选择。

papers.name: SkillDOS
papers.title: SkillDOS: Token Amplification Attacks via Poisoned Skills in LLM Agents
papers.summary: A resource-exhaustion attack that splits a poisoned skill into an inducer and an amplifier and optimizes them in two stages to raise output-token use while preserving the final answer.
papers.summary_zh: 一种资源耗尽攻击：把投毒 skill 拆成诱导部分和放大部分，分两阶段优化，在保持最终答案不变的同时提高输出 token 消耗。

papers.name: Future-SE
papers.title: Live Skill Evolution for Forecasting Agents with Delayed Outcome Feedback
papers.summary: A live skill-evolution framework for forecasting agents that refines a library of thinking and working skills once delayed outcomes resolve, keeping the base model and harness fixed.
papers.summary_zh: 面向预测类 agent 的在线 skill 演化框架，在延迟的结果揭晓后修订由判断类和取证类 skill 组成的库，基座模型和 harness 保持不变。

papers.name: SkillInertiaBench
papers.title: Following the Skill, Failing the Patient:Procedural Inertia in Clinical Agents
papers.summary: A clinician-reviewed benchmark of procedural inertia, where clinical agents keep following a skill after new evidence invalidates it, together with an inference-time gate that rechecks the active skill against the patient state.
papers.summary_zh: 一个经临床医生审核的基准，衡量临床 agent 在新证据使 skill 失效后仍继续执行它的“流程惯性”，并提出在推理时对照患者状态复核当前 skill 的门控机制。

papers.name: AdaCraft
papers.title: AdaCraft: Evolving Reliable Skills for Articulated 3D Generation
papers.summary: Evolves reusable skills for articulated 3D asset generation from execution feedback, using a motion memory of geometric conditions and an adaptive budget on how many rules each update may change.
papers.summary_zh: 从执行反馈中为铰接 3D 资产生成演化可复用的 skill，使用记录几何条件的运动记忆，以及限制每次更新可改动规则数量的自适应预算。

papers.name: SCPO
papers.title: Skill in the Loop: Explicit Skill Declaration and Attribution for Agent Training
papers.summary: Has the agent explicitly declare the skill guiding each action, then uses retrospective feedback on skill use to jointly optimize the policy with GRPO and update the skill bank.
papers.summary_zh: 让 agent 在每步行动前显式声明所依据的 skill，再利用对 skill 使用效果的回顾性反馈，同时用 GRPO 优化策略并更新 skill 库。

papers.name: SkillCred
papers.title: SkillCred: Online Value Estimation for Evolving Agent Skills
papers.summary: Keeps competing versions of each evolving skill and estimates their value online from local progress signals in normal trajectories, routing among versions by Thompson sampling and promoting or archiving them.
papers.summary_zh: 为每个演化中的 skill 保留多个竞争版本，从正常执行轨迹的局部进展信号在线估计其价值，用 Thompson 采样在版本间路由并决定晋升或归档。

papers.name: AtmoSkillRSI
papers.title: AtmoSkillRSI: Skill Formation and Recursive Refinement in Atmospheric Workflows
papers.summary: A controlled setting for persistent skill formation and refinement in atmospheric workflow construction with Earth2Studio, comparing sequential and task-parallel experience organization.
papers.summary_zh: 在基于 Earth2Studio 的大气科学工作流构建中研究持久 skill 的形成与反复修订的受控设定，比较顺序和任务并行两种经验组织方式。
